natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: The concurrent activation and onboarding-completion declines make onboarding simplification the most directly relevant durable lever, with prior evidence of improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Aggressive promotional pricing is tempting given competitor pressure, but inherited evidence indicates a material retention downside that threatens sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the onboarding and pricing source records before final commitment, while treating transferability to current conditions as uncertain.
